description: Direct Visitor ID Service calls to dpm.demdex.net/id. Adobe documents d_ver=2 as required, and either d_orgid to mint an ECID or d_mid to reuse one. Audience Manager /event and cookie sync on cm.everesttech.net are not contracted.

params.name: d_ver
params.description: Adobe documents d_ver as required and tells you to leave it set as d_ver=2.
params.fix_hint: Send d_ver=2 on every Visitor ID Service call.

params.name: d_orgid
params.description: It is the IMS org ID. Adobe's generate-a-MID call sends d_orgid with d_ver=2.
params.fix_hint: Send d_orgid when you do not already have an ECID, or send d_mid when you do.

params.name: d_mid
params.description: It is an existing ECID. Adobe's reuse call sends d_mid with d_ver=2.
params.fix_hint: Send d_mid when you already have an Experience Cloud ID for the visitor.

params.name: d_cid
params.description: Optional Data Provider ID, DPUUID, and authentication state, joined with %01.

params.name: d_cb
params.description: The vendor documents `d_cb` in the request contract.

params.name: d_blob
params.description: Encrypted metadata blob, limited to512 bytes of decoded string content.

params.name: dcs_region
params.description: DCS region identifier. The published registry is a geographic routing table, and account/API updates may add regions.

params.name: d_cid_ic
params.description: Integration code and user ID separated by %01. Repeated d_cid_ic values are accepted, with optional0/1/2 authentication state.

params.name: d_caller
params.description: Caller identification; no published character grammar.

params.name: d_coppa
params.description: Disables third-party-cookie use. Published table specifies behavior without a complete literal-value enum.

params.name: d_cts
params.description: Optional account-enabled traits/segments return mode:1legacy segment IDs or2current IDs.

params.name: d_dpid
params.description: Deprecated data provider ID, still supported in ID and event calls.

params.name: d_dpuuid
params.description: Deprecated provider-specific user ID, still supported in ID and event calls.

params.name: d_dst
params.description: Include URL destination data in a JSON response.

params.name: d_dst_filter
params.description: Reserved Analytics/Audience Manager integration attribute with unpublished value grammar.

params.name: d_jsonv
params.description: Response JSON version1;0disables ID syncs.

params.name: d_nsid
params.description: JavaScript container namespace used by DIL for ID synchronization; account namespace registration is external.

params.name: d_ptfm
params.description: Published platform literal registry.

params.name: d_rs
params.description: Deprecated reserved Analytics/Audience Manager attribute, without a published value grammar.

params.name: d_rtbd
params.description: JSON response selector. Required when a JSON response is requested; absence returns a pixel.

params.name: d_sid
params.description: Trait/segment score ID; membership is account configuration.

params.name: d_tdpid
params.description: Data source for trait evaluation. Public examples use/event, and the linked generic DCS table does not exclude/id.

params.name: d_tdpid_ic
params.description: Integration-code form of trait-evaluation data source. Source uses/event examples without declaring/id exclusion.

params.name: d_uuid
params.description: Audience Manager visitor UUID when absent from cookie; numeric-only grammar is not published in this table.

params.name: h_host
params.description: Client collection hostname represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_user-agent
params.description: User-Agent header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_accept-language
params.description: Accept-Language header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_referer
params.description: Referer header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_referrer
params.description: Referrer header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: h_date
params.description: Date header value represented as DCS HTTP-header attribute, without a complete serialized query grammar.

params.name: c_*
params.description: Public customer-defined DCS attribute. The key prefix is published; the value schema is configured by the customer.

params.name: p_*
params.description: Private customer-defined DCS attribute, used for trait evaluation and not logged. The key prefix is published; the value schema is configured by the customer.

rules.message: The Visitor ID Service call has neither d_orgid nor d_mid. Adobe documents d_orgid to mint an ECID and d_mid to reuse one.
rules.fix_hint: Send d_orgid to request a new ECID, or d_mid to reuse an existing one.

rules.message: The DCS region is absent from the current published routing table. Confirm its availability with the Adobe DCS Region API.
